notice: Summaries are plain-language routing aids, not legal interpretation. Titles and dates were checked against acquisition.gov on the verified_on date; a null source_version_date means the date was not verified and version mismatch checks are skipped.

clauses.title: System for Award Management
clauses.summary: Offeror must be registered in SAM at offer submission (unless an alternate applies) and keep the registration current.
typical_effects: Offer may be ineligible for award without an active SAM registration.
verification_questions: Is the offeror's SAM registration active on the offer date?
Do the UEI and CAGE in the offer match SAM?

clauses.title: Representation Regarding Certain Telecommunications and Video Surveillance Services or Equipment
clauses.summary: Offeror represents whether it will provide or uses covered telecommunications equipment or services (Section 889).
typical_effects: A required representation; omission can make the offer incomplete.
verification_questions: Has the Section 889 representation been completed for this offer?

clauses.title: Prohibition on Contracting for Certain Telecommunications and Video Surveillance Services or Equipment
clauses.summary: Prohibits providing covered telecommunications equipment or services and requires reporting if discovered.
typical_effects: Supplied products must not include covered telecommunications equipment.
verification_questions: Does any offered product or supplier component fall under the covered-equipment prohibition?

clauses.title: Covered Telecommunications Equipment or Services-Representation
clauses.summary: Annual SAM representation on covered telecommunications equipment or services.
typical_effects: Representation normally completed in SAM; confirm it is current.
verification_questions: Is the SAM representation for covered telecommunications current?

clauses.title: Certification Regarding Responsibility Matters
clauses.summary: Offeror certifies responsibility matters such as debarment, indictments, and delinquent taxes.
typical_effects: A required certification; an unresolved item needs human and possibly legal review.
verification_questions: Has the responsibility-matters certification been completed accurately?

clauses.title: Variation in Quantity
clauses.summary: States the permitted over/under shipment percentage for delivered quantities.
typical_effects: Delivered quantity outside the stated variation may be rejected.
verification_questions: What variation percentage is stated, and can the supplier ship within it?

clauses.title: Delivery of Excess Quantities
clauses.summary: Addresses how excess delivered quantities are handled and paid.
typical_effects: Excess quantities may be returned or retained without payment.
verification_questions: Does the shipment plan avoid excess quantities?

clauses.title: Instructions to Offerors—Commercial Products and Commercial Services
clauses.summary: Standard submission instructions for commercial acquisitions, including required offer content and late-offer rules.
typical_effects: Missing required offer content or late submission can make the offer non-responsive.
verification_questions: Does the offer include every item listed in the instructions (addenda included)?
Will the offer be received before the stated time?

clauses.title: Offeror Representations and Certifications—Commercial Products and Commercial Services
clauses.summary: Offeror representations and certifications for commercial acquisitions, normally completed in SAM with any required paragraphs in the offer.
typical_effects: Incomplete representations can make the offer ineligible.
verification_questions: Are the SAM representations current, and are any paragraphs not in SAM completed in the offer?

clauses.title: Notice of Total Small Business Set-Aside
clauses.summary: Only small business concerns under the stated size standard may compete.
typical_effects: An offeror that is not small under the NAICS size standard is ineligible.
verification_questions: Is the company small under the solicitation's NAICS size standard?

clauses.title: Limitations on Subcontracting
clauses.summary: Limits the share of contract amount that may be paid to non-similarly-situated subcontractors on set-aside awards.
typical_effects: Supply reseller models may need a nonmanufacturer-rule analysis.
verification_questions: Does the sourcing plan comply with the limitation (or a nonmanufacturer rule applies)?

clauses.title: Buy American-Supplies
clauses.summary: Domestic end products are required unless an exception applies.
typical_effects: Foreign-origin products may be unacceptable or evaluated with a price penalty.
verification_questions: What is the country of origin of each offered end product?

clauses.title: Trade Agreements
clauses.summary: Only U.S.-made or designated-country end products may be delivered for covered acquisitions.
typical_effects: Products from non-designated countries may be unacceptable.
verification_questions: Is each end product from the U.S. or a designated country?

clauses.title: Inspection of Supplies-Fixed-Price
clauses.summary: Government inspection and acceptance rights for supplies under fixed-price contracts.
typical_effects: Nonconforming supplies may be rejected or require correction.
verification_questions: Can the supplier meet the stated inspection and acceptance point?

clauses.title: F.o.b. Destination
clauses.summary: Contractor delivers to the stated destination and bears transportation cost and risk until delivery.
typical_effects: Price must include freight to destination; transit time counts against the delivery date.
verification_questions: Does the quote include delivery to destination and account for transit time?

clauses.title: Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
clauses.summary: Requires adequate security for covered defense information and cyber incident reporting.
typical_effects: Handling covered defense information requires NIST SP 800-171 security controls.
verification_questions: Will covered defense information be handled, and are required controls in place?

clauses.title: Notice of NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements
clauses.summary: Offeror must have a current NIST SP 800-171 DoD assessment posted when the requirement applies.
typical_effects: Missing assessment can make the offeror ineligible for award.
verification_questions: Is a current assessment summary posted in SPRS when required?

clauses.title: NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements
clauses.summary: Contract clause on NIST SP 800-171 DoD assessments and access for assessment.
typical_effects: Assessment obligations flow during performance.
verification_questions: Are assessment obligations understood for this award?

clauses.title: Item Unique Identification and Valuation
clauses.summary: Requires unique item identification marking for specified items.
typical_effects: Items may need IUID marking before delivery.
verification_questions: Do any delivered items require IUID marking, and can the supplier provide it?

clauses.title: Buy American and Balance of Payments Program
clauses.summary: DoD domestic-end-product requirements with qualifying-country provisions.
typical_effects: Nonqualifying foreign end products may be unacceptable or penalized.
verification_questions: Is each end product domestic or from a qualifying country?

clauses.title: Restriction on Acquisition of Certain Articles Containing Specialty Metals
clauses.summary: Specialty metals in covered items must be melted or produced in the U.S. or a qualifying country unless an exception applies.
typical_effects: Supplier certification of specialty-metal origin may be required.
verification_questions: Do offered items contain specialty metals, and what is their melt origin?

clauses.title: Wide Area WorkFlow Payment Instructions
clauses.summary: Payment requests are submitted electronically through Wide Area WorkFlow (WAWF / PIEE).
typical_effects: Invoicing requires a PIEE/WAWF account after award.
verification_questions: Is a PIEE/WAWF vendor account available for invoicing?

clauses.title: Sources of Electronic Parts
clauses.summary: Electronic parts must come from authorized or trusted suppliers to reduce counterfeit risk.
typical_effects: Supplier traceability documentation may be required for electronic parts.
verification_questions: Are electronic parts sourced from the original manufacturer or an authorized/trusted supplier?

clauses.title: Disputes – Agreement to Use Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)
clauses.summary: DLA provision on agreeing to use alternative dispute resolution; includes an opt-out checkbox.
typical_effects: The opt-out election is an offeror choice to confirm before submission.
verification_questions: Has the offeror decided whether to opt out of the ADR agreement?
